Reading the table: a positive number is minutes (or seconds in the last column) the fix could take off, as a prediction or upper bound. Zero means the fix would not have changed that run's critical path. The edge-specific column prunes, besides plain removable edges, the ruled edges whose items all have Produces lines; rulings are mapped to edges by task ids or shared package name (see script header), so it is a prediction under that mapping.
